document.title: Dona Ana County BOCC Amended Agenda, Regular Meeting October 13, 2026

note: Dona Ana County BOCC amended agenda, October 13, 2026: two Project Jupiter items among routine business
excerpt:
AMENDED AGENDA

The following will be considered at the Regular Meeting of the Doña Ana County Board of County
Commissioners to be held on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 9:00 AM in the Doña Ana County Commission
Chambers, 1st Floor, Doña Ana County Government Center, 845 North Motel Boulevard, Las Cruces, New
Mexico:

• Invocation /Moment of Silence

• Pledge of Allegiance

• Roll Call of Commission Members Present and Determination of Quorum

COMMISSION CONVENES AS THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS AND THE COUNTY
BOARD OF FINANCE IN OPEN SESSION

• CHANGES TO THE AGENDA: Deborah Weir, Lucio Luttrell, Stephen Lopez, Acting County Managers.

• CONSENT AGENDA: The Board will be asked to approve by one motion the following items of recurring
or routine business:

1.
Accept a grant award from the Substance Abuse and Mental Health
Services Administration (SAMHSA) in the amount of $196,956.00, and
approve associated budget revision and resolution.
Jamie Michael,
HHS Director

2.
Approve a no-cost change order for a 3-month time extension on
Contract #23-169 TO#5 for Mendez Pond Construction due to
availability of construction materials
Michael Garza,
Engineer Supervisor

3.
Accept donation of 14’x72’ Construction Trailer from Charles
Dickerson INC.
Justin Weaver,
Project Manager

4.
Approve contract award in an amount not to exceed $129,600 to Cruces
Creatives for Comprehensive Planning, Coordination, and Execution
Services for a 2027 Renaissance Fair Event in Doña Ana County.
Denisse Carter,
Economic Development
Director

5.
Approve a Resolution Adopting the 2026 Doña Ana County Multi-
Jurisdictional Hazard Mitigation Plan
Amanda Bowen,
OEM Director

6.
Approval to submit the Fire Rescue Department policies and procedures
manual as documentation of compliance with Special Audit Findings
#2026-029S, #2026-030S, and #2026-031S.
Stephen Lopez,
Acting County Manager

7.
Approval to submit the plan that the County Manager's Office will
require departments to submit and maintain complete records for agenda
items for confirmation of compliance with Special Audit Finding
#2026-032S.
Stephen Lopez,
Acting County Manager
October 13, 2026

8.
Approval to submit the Doña Ana County Litigation and Conflict
Counsel Standard Operating Procedure as documentation of compliance
with Special Audit Finding #2026-036S.
Alonzo Maestas,
Deputy County Attorney

9.
Allocate $2,000 to the City of Las Cruces to help cover the cost of
replacing and updating the plaques that honor veterans at the Las Cruces
Veteran's Park
Susie Kimble,
Commissioner, District 3
Christopher Schaljo-
Hernandez,
Commissioner, District 1

10. Authorize Acting County Managers to provide a letter of support to
New Mexico State University for a grant proposal related to water
desalination research in the County.
Stephen Lopez,
Acting County Manager

11. Proclaim October as Cybersecurity Awareness Month in Doña Ana
County
Susie Kimble,
Commissioner, District 3

12. Proclaim October as Domestic Violence Month in Doña Ana County
Susana Chaparro,
Commissioner, District 4

13. Proclaim October as Breast Cancer Awareness Month in Doña Ana
County
Susana Chaparro,
Commissioner, District 4

14. Appointment of Don Bassett and Marcus Wells as the District 4
members to Community Monitoring Committee Related to Project
Jupiter.
Stephen Lopez,
Acting County Manager
